note: Dated artifacts are immutable; this companion adds provenance and two corrections the original should have carried.

provenance.dataset: origin-synthetic-floors-v2, SEED_BASE 500000 (scripts/perceiver-bench.mjs), 24 floors x 3 styles, balanced 8/8/8 finish/refuse/escalate
provenance.raw_responses: bench-out/ is gitignored; per-arm aggregates and paired deltas in the companion_to file are the retained record.

corrections.wrong: Headline copy attributed anchors-exact 94.4% to "grid references". 94.4% is arm A2 (refs + counting prompt).
corrections.right: Grid references ALONE (arm A1) measure 90.1% anchors-exact vs 5.6% baseline. A2 measures 94.4%, but the counting prompt's marginal gain over A1 is not significant (paired sign test p = 0.45). Quote 90.1% for the refs lever, or credit both arms explicitly.

100% is 71 of 71 SCORED parses; 1 of 72 was VOIDed by the deterministic gate and excluded from geometry means (counted as unparsed). The gate catching one bad parse mid-benchmark is disclosure, not noise.

statistical_note: Pooled n=72 per arm is 24 floors x 3 style replicates; replicates of one floor are not independent, so the effective independent n is nearer 24. With 60 paired wins / 0 losses on anchors the direction is not in doubt; treat the p-values as bounded by the clustering rather than exact.
noise_floor_note: A0R-vs-A0 is all-ties on anchorsExact and dimsMatch; role-F1 metrics show small nonzero run-to-run jitter (e.g. obstaclesF1 +1/-5/=66). "All ties" applies to the two discrete metrics only.
